subtitle: Lesson 4 · Users and Access

caption: On the New User form, User License sits right above Profile — it's chosen first because it limits which profiles are even selectable.
This user's License is set to Chatter Free — notice Profile is still empty. Chatter Free doesn't unlock most standard profiles at all.
Permission sets carry their own License field — this one requires a Salesforce license, so a Chatter Free user could never be assigned it.

subtitle: The single mandatory permission container every user must have exactly one of.
